6.text: While silver royalty companies offer attractive investment opportunities
it’s crucial to understand the risks involved: Silver Price Volatility: While royalty payments are relatively stable
they are still tied to silver prices.
A significant drop in silver prices could negatively impact royalty company revenues.
Operational Risks: Although royalty companies are insulated from operational risks
the underlying silver producers may face challenges such as mine closures or production disruptions.

7.text: Diversify Your Portfolio: Don’t put all your eggs in one basket.
Combine silver royalty companies with other investments to create a well-diversified portfolio.
Understand Tax Implications: Consult with a tax advisor to understand the tax implications of investing in silver royalty companies.
Ignoring Royalty Terms: Don’t just look at revenue; carefully examine the terms of the royalty agreements
including the royalty rate and duration.
